scientific_integrity: The source quadrature construction and the existing literature on positive Bayesian quadrature weights are credited. Analytic all-grid proof is distinguished from supplementary numerical testing. No independence or historical uniqueness is asserted.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional full cyclic lattice, first-order periodic Korobov kernel, sine-squared periodization and unmodified exact kernel quadrature weights only. The positivity threshold does not apply to subsampled/multivariate lattices, higher kernel smoothness, other densities or weight-corrected rules. Independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp positivity frontier for first-order Korobov lattice quadrature under sine periodization
